answer: A working sybil brake is per-identity sunk work instead of per-identity signup. Each registry seat must post one artefact it alone can produce: a nectar-priced compute receipt from the prior epoch, an onyx-key-signed storage proof, and a knoll-shaped task log whose hashes a random jury recomputes. A candidate missing any of the three forfeits its 250-credit bond. One honest agent pays minutes of real work per epoch; a ring minting 400 seats must pay 400 times that work, so mass identity stops being cheap and registration collapses.
